#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <iomanip>

class RPNCalculator {
private:
    std::vector<double> stack;
    
    void push(double value) {
        stack.push_back(value);
    }
    
    double pop() {
        if (stack.empty()) {
            throw std::runtime_error("Stack underflow");
        }
        double value = stack.back();
        stack.pop_back();
        return value;
    }
    
    double peek() const {
        if (stack.empty()) {
            throw std::runtime_error("Stack underflow");
        }
        return stack.back();
    }
    
public:
    std::vector<std::string> tokenize(const std::string& input) {
        std::vector<std::string> tokens;
        std::istringstream iss(input);
        std::string token;
        
        while (iss >> token) {
            tokens.push_back(token);
        }
        
        return tokens;
    }
    
    double applyOperator(const std::string& op, double b, double a) {
        if (op == "+") {
            return a + b;
        } else if (op == "-") {
            return a - b;
        } else if (op == "*") {
            return a * b;
        } else if (op == "/") {
            if (b == 0.0) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Division by zero");
            }
            return a / b;
        } else if (op == "^") {
            return std::pow(a, b);
        } else if (op == "sqrt") {
            if (a < 0.0) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Cannot take square root of negative number");
            }
            return std::sqrt(a);
        } else {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unknown operator: " + op);
        }
    }
    
    double evaluate(const std::vector<std::string>& tokens) {
        stack.clear();
        
        for (const std::string& token : tokens) {
            if (token.empty()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check if it's a number (including negative numbers and decimals)
            bool isNumber = true;
            size_t startPos = 0;
            
            // Handle negative numbers
            if (token[0] == '-') {
                if (token.length() == 1) {
                    isNumber = false;
                } else {
                    startPos = 1;
                }
            }
            
            if (isNumber) {
                // Check if remaining part is a valid number
                bool hasDecimal = false;
                for (size_t i = startPos; i < token.length(); i++) {
                    char c = token[i];
                    if (c == '.') {
                        if (hasDecimal) {
                            isNumber = false;
                            break;
                        }
                        hasDecimal = true;
                    } else if (!std::isdigit(c)) {
                        isNumber = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (isNumber) {
                try {
                    double value = std::stod(token);
                    push(value);
                } catch (const std::exception&) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Invalid number: " + token);
                }
            } else {
                // It's an operator
                if (token == "sqrt") {
                    // sqrt takes only one operand
                    if (stack.size() < 1) {
                        throw std::runtime_error("Insufficient operands for sqrt");
                    }
                    double a = pop();
                    double result = applyOperator(token, a, 0);
                    push(result);
                } else {
                    // Binary operators (+, -, *, /, ^) take two operands
                    if (stack.size() < 2) {
                        throw std::runtime_error("Insufficient operands for " + token);
                    }
                    double b = pop();
                    double a = pop();
                    double result = applyOperator(token, b, a);
                    push(result);
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (stack.size() != 1) {
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid expression: " + std::to_string(stack.size()) + " values left on stack");
        }
        
        return pop();
    }
    
    void printHelp() {
        std::cout << "RPN Calculator - Reverse Polish Notation Calculator" << std::endl;
        std::cout << "Usage: Enter expressions in postfix notation" << std::endl;
        std::cout << std::endl;
        std::cout << "Operators:" << std::endl;
        std::cout << "  +       Addition (a b +)           - adds a and b" << std::endl;
        std::cout << "  -       Subtraction (a b -)        - subtracts b from a" << std::endl;
        std::cout << "  *       Multiplication (a b *)     - multiplies a and b" << std::endl;
        std::cout << "  /       Division (a b /)           - divides a by b" << std::endl;
        std::cout << "  ^       Exponentiation (a b ^)     - raises a to the power of b" << std::endl;
        std::cout << "  sqrt    Square root (a sqrt)       - takes square root of a" << std::endl;
        std::cout << std::endl;
        std::cout << "Examples:" << std::endl;
        std::cout << "  5 3 +       => 8" << std::endl;
        std::cout << "  10 2 /      => 5" << std::endl;
        std::cout << "  5 2 * 4 +   => 14" << std::endl;
        std::cout << "  3 4 2 * 1 + - => 1 (equivalent to 3 + 4 * 2 + 1)" << std::endl;
        std::cout << "  2 3 ^       => 8" << std::endl;
        std::cout << "  16 sqrt     => 4" << std::endl;
        std::cout << std::endl;
        std::cout << "Type 'help' for this message, 'quit' to exit." << std::endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    RPNCalculator calculator;
    std::string line;
    
    // Print welcome message
    std::cout << "RPN Calculator" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Type 'help' for instructions, 'quit' to exit." << std::endl;
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
    // Read from stdin until EOF
    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        // Check for quit command
        if (line == "quit" || line == "exit" || line == "q") {
            break;
        }
        
        // Check for help command
        if (line == "help" || line == "?") {
            calculator.printHelp();
            std::cout << std::endl;
            continue;
        }
        
        // Skip empty lines
        if (line.empty()) {
            continue;
        }
        
        try {
            // Tokenize the input
            std::vector<std::string> tokens = calculator.tokenize(line);
            
            // Evaluate the expression
            double result = calculator.evaluate(tokens);
            
            // Print result with 10 decimal places precision
            std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(10) << result << std::endl;
        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            std::cerr << "Error: " << e.what() << std::endl;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << "Goodbye!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
